The winner of the dream match was El 
Condor Pasa. Not only did she win, but she 
fired up the race as the ultimate 
entertainer.

At the award ceremony, she declared that 
the fun and excitement the spectators 
experienced in this race would continue to 
reach them even after she takes on the 
world.

El Condor Pasa put on a show like a true 
entertainer. Cheers praising her 
performance echoed across the racetrack 
endlessly.
